I try not to leave negative reviews, but I honestly was disappointed in this bundle. The covers are mostly black and white and frankly not attractive to me. Several of the " planners " were quite short and didn't strike me as worthwhile.

That's my fault for not reading closely and being unfamiliar with how digital templates work in GoodNotes. For people eyeing a bundle from lovingmondays, please consider what you want from a digital planner. Make sure this is it. The value is okay if your tastes align and you like hopping between files.
